report.summary: Plan to fix _human_bytes PiB bug, implement available_vendors, add missing 'matches' field in SearchReport, wire _emit_ok calls in slice.py, and harden root path resolution.
risks: Fixing _human_bytes may affect all callers expecting TiB for large sizes.
available_vendors implementation may break if vendors.py has other incomplete stubs.
Adding 'matches' field may change SearchReport shape; lint.py compare() fix is essential.
Wiring _emit_ok in slice.py may reveal missing egress gate logic elsewhere.
Root path refactor may break if files move; tests must cover both current and future depths.
todos: Gate 0: Fix _human_bytes in daedalus/council/vendors.py to reach PiB.
Gate 0: Ensure SearchReport always includes 'matches' field in daedalus/memory/embeddings.py.
Gate 1: Refactor root path resolution to use a shared function.

items.title: Fix _human_bytes to return PiB for sizes >= 1024 TiB
items.why_now: Current implementation never reaches PiB; very large byte sizes are misrepresented as TiB, causing incorrect output.

steps.do: Modify _human_bytes to continue dividing until n < 1024, allowing unit to advance to PiB. Change loop condition to 'while n >= 1024' and ensure unit progression stops at PiB.
steps.verified_by: Run _human_bytes(1024**5) and assert output equals '1.0 PiB'.

items.assumption: The _human_bytes function exists in vendors.py; the exact line numbers are unknown.

items.title: Implement available_vendors function
items.why_now: available_vendors is listed in __all__ but not implemented; any code calling it will fail with AttributeError.

steps.do: Implement available_vendors to return a list of available vendor names by inspecting registered providers.
steps.verified_by: Run 'python -c "from daedalus.council.vendors import available_vendors; print(available_vendors())"' and verify it returns a non-empty list.

items.assumption: The function signature is known; the exact implementation details depend on how vendors are registered.

items.title: Ensure SearchReport always includes 'matches' field
items.why_now: lint.py compare() uses next() without default, raising StopIteration if 'matches' is missing. This causes crashes.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/memory/embeddings.py lines 1499-1503. If SearchReport is returned without 'matches', add an empty list for 'matches'.
steps.verified_by: Run 'grep -n "matches" daedalus/memory/embeddings.py' and verify all SearchReport returns include 'matches' key.

steps.do: In daedalus/gui/lint.py line 249, change next() to next(..., []) to provide a default empty list.
steps.verified_by: Run test_lint.py or manually invoke compare() with a report missing 'matches' and confirm no StopIteration.

items.assumption: The exact line numbers in embeddings.py are correct; the lint.py fix is straightforward.

items.title: Wire _emit_ok calls in slice.py to enforce egress gates
items.why_now: _emit_ok is defined but never called in the provided chunk; egress gates are not enforced, allowing potential data leaks.

steps.do: Search the full daedalus/structcore/slice.py for all places where emission occurs and add calls to _emit_ok before emitting.
steps.verified_by: Run 'grep -n "_emit_ok" daedalus/structcore/slice.py' and confirm at least one call exists in emission paths.

items.assumption: The emission paths are identifiable; the _emit_ok function signature is compatible.

items.title: Harden root path resolution against future directory depth changes
items.why_now: Current ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] is fragile; a subpackage move would break it.

steps.do: Refactor both daedalus/memory/__init__.py and daedalus/spine/ledger.py to compute ROOT via a shared function (e.g., from daedalus import ROOT) or by using a marker file.
steps.verified_by: Run 'python -c "from pathlib import Path; from daedalus.memory import ROOT as ROOT1; from daedalus.spine.ledger import ROOT as ROOT2; assert ROOT1 == ROOT2"' and confirm equality.

items.assumption: A shared root definition can be placed in daedalus/__init__.py or a similar location.
